notes.title: beta v0.13 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi there. It's been a while. Sorry for the radio silence here, but as compensation, here's the largest update I've ever released for DI so far.

This update is disgustingly big, adding a bunch of things, reworking way more things, and just making everything more gooder.



this update was so large i had to split the changelog into 3 parts:
NEW STUFF:
NEW MODIFIER: Daily Challenge - Force enables all unlocks, but disables progression. Sets a custom random seed. Play a unique run everyday and compare your score with friends.

NEW MODIFIER: Weaponized - All shop weapons get a random positive and negative trait. Each weapon has it's own unique pool of traits to choose from. You can see the traits on each weapon in the Shop UI and in the Catalogue Menu.

NEW RANDOM EVENT: Slow Healing - Healing Power and Regen Speed are 50% worse.

NEW RANDOM EVENT: Fatigue - Every Fresh Kill you get grants you -1.5% Weapon Speed for the rest of the wave.

NEW QUEST DEBUFF: Debased - Your weapon progressively gets worse and worse base damage until you reload or switch weapons.

NEW QUEST DEBUFF: Wide Angle Lens - Increases horizontal Bullet Spread by 35%.

NEW QUEST DEBUFF: Point Blank - Increases Bullet Spread by 35%.

NEW QUEST DEBUFF: Shielded Foes - Reduces incoming damage by 30% to foes that are undamaged.

NEW QUEST DEBUFF: Expired Food - Healing/Regen items give 35% less health.

NEW QUEST DEBUFF: Deep Wounds - Regeneration is 50% slower.

NEW PASSIVE ITEM: Modified Stomach - Grants +20% Max HP, but reduces Healing Power and Regen Speed by 5%. (ONLY AVAILABLE IN DAILY RUNS)

NEW PASSIVE ITEM: Quantum Bullets - Random chance to gain +1 projectile and +0.4 piercing. (ONLY AVAILABLE IN DAILY RUNS)

NEW PASSIVE ITEM: Fresh Frenzy - Healing Power is 30% worse. Gain +0.3% Max HP PERMANENTLY every time you get a Fresh Kill. (ONLY AVAILABLE IN DAILY RUNS)
REWORKS/REBALANCES:
DAMAGE REWORK: All health values are now 10x more precise, allowing for smaller changes to health and damage across the entire game. AKA, you'll notice smaller damage upgrades being more effective now.

DAMAGE REWORK (Part 2): All DMG multipliers will now scale exponentially, making the game slightly easier.

DAMAGE REWORK (Part 3) - Healing and Regen items can now be scaled by Passive Items, making them heal more or less.

DAMAGE REWORK (Part 4) - Regeneration is now 10x smoother, and can be slowed/hastened by Passive Items.

DAMAGE REWORK (Part 5) - Added support for Max HP increases/decreases. Max HP buffs will also retroactively scale borrowed HP from debts to prevent cheese.

ACCURACY REWORK - All weapons now have their own custom Bullet Spread, which is separate from inaccuracy and recoil. This allows for the creation of custom weapon spray patterns, which are unaffected by recoil and inaccuracy. Currently only 2 spray patterns are used across all of the weapons. Does not apply to melee attacks.

Crosshair now has a "Detailed" mode which separates the new Bullet Spread from the inaccuracy and recoil.

ARMOR REWORK - All armors are now weaker and cheaper across the board, but now uses the same system that Passive Items do, allowing for much more interesting armor mechanics. Armor can now also display their own custom UI elements on the HUD.

Top Hat Armor - Now grants +25% Protection and +50 Durability.

Top Hat :) Armor - Now grants +50% Protection and +35 Durability, but you gain +1 durability each time you get a Fresh Kill.

Bow Tie Armor - Now grants +40% Protection and +40 Durability, plus gives you up to +13% Weapon Speed based on the Bow Tie's durability.

Party Hat Armor - Now grants +75% Protection and +150 Durability, but the durability will decrease by 0.3 every second that enemies are still alive.

Debilitated Modifier - Will now only apply a debuff to you upon entering a wave while not in debt, instead of every wave.

Stun Crossbow Weapon - No longer has pixel-perfect accuracy.

Double Shotgun Weapon - Bullet Spread is now the same as Green Shotgun, but horizontal spread is 100% wider.

Grenade Launcher Weapon - Will now always gib enemies. 20% of the total damage is now dealt upon impact instead of on the explosion.

P.P.D.S. Weapon - Reduced Fresh Bonus and Base Damage by ~50%.

Defenseless Debuff - Now only buffs nearby foes by 50% instead of 65%.

Encumbered Debuff - Now grants -6% Weapon Speed per weapon, instead of -8%.

Fake Bullet Debuff - Can now lower your total damage all the way down to 0.1.

Loose Grip Debuff - Now gives +50% Recoil, instead of a flat +2.

Rotten Weapons Debuff - Now gives -1 Fresh Bonus instead of -2.

Food Coma Debuff - Now gives up to -15% Player Speed instead of -20%.

Torn Pockets Debuff - Reduced chance for player to lose money on hit.

Yielding Debuff - Now grants -20% Player Speed upon taking damage instead of -35%.

Broken Glasses Debuff - Reduced the inaccuracy debuff by 50%.

Old Magazine Random Event - Random damage output is now (0.5 - 1.25), was originally (0.5 - 0.99).

Big Bullets Passive - Now grants +50% Recoil instead of a flat +1.

Bonus Armor Passive - Now does nothing if you do not have any Armor equipped.

Compact Gunpowder Passive - Changed completely. Now grants better DMG and worse accuracy depending on the number of projectiles on your current weapon. Has diminishing returns.

Hat Hat Passive - Can now reduce incoming damage all the way down to 0.1.

Jump Shot Passive - Now also reduces Bullet Spread.

Spray n Pray Passive - Gives less inaccuracy, but now also grants +15% worse Bullet Spread.

Super Glue Passive - Now makes your weapons recover from recoil +15% better.

Too Many Bullets Passive - No longer reduces accuracy, as that's done automatically by the weapons themselves.

Wealth Jar Passive - Maximum Amount capped to 3, now also reduces your Max HP by 25%.

Throwable Bombs Consumable - Now always gib enemies.

Adjusted the prices and spawn chances of most of the items in the game.

Random Events - Rebalanced chances of a majority of the event to occur.
EVERYTHING ELSE:
Added Rarity values to the descriptions of every single item in the game. The values dont actually do anything, they're just meant to represent the chance of them spawning inside of a shop.

Added the ability for the user to set a Custom Seed, allowing you to play the same run over and over again.

Added the option to disable the Fresh Colors on the crosshair.

Added the menu star background to the Canvases in Level 1 and 2's shops.

Added 12 new functions to Passive Items.

Added progression checks to all unlocks in the game, giving the player/game the option to prevent new items from being unlocked. (Used for Daily Runs.)

Many parts of the game now have their own separate RNG calculations, preventing things like bullet casings from influencing the RNG of shop item pools. (Used for Custom Seed support.)

Fixed speed calculations on Motion Blur and Speed Demon and Sesame Seeds.

Fixed Cheese Artifact not doing any damage.

Optimized the code of a bunch of passive items.

Cvar Auto Updater script is now able to modify engine-level cvars, allowing me to fix "problematic" default values.

Fixed Jump Shot passive item not being counted as a rental.

Added a new popup to the HUD when you purchase any item. Very useful when using the Chest Shops.

Crosshair is now set to "Simple" by default, instead of Detailed.

Replaced the engine's damage flash with a custom one that supports Max HP changes.

Death Marked enemies will now always properly gib if their gibhealth value is changed.

Tweaked the weapon recoil offset code to prevent the weapon sprite from ever being completely off screen.

Fixed the fix for the teleport fix for the Shop Stalls.

Added new Shop Inventory items that can influence shop stalls in various ways, including adding new UI elements.

Added new warnings to the Exit Popup which tells the player to do things like "you only have 1 weapon" or "you dont have any armor equipped" or "you don't have a side quest equipped".

Ghost Shops now tell you to upgrade the shop to reveal the corresponding shop.

Level 2 only - Now displays the next Arena every time the Arena changes.

Added more stats to the player stats HUD on the fullscreen map.

Added ability for Passive Items to add custom UI elements to the Catalogue Menu.

Added another check to Passive Items to allow them to hide from the Item HUD without also hiding from the Catalogue Menu.

Fixed the New Game Menu's Swag Bar positioning.

Added more info to the Death Screen, like the current level, random seed, whether or not you disabled progression, etc.

Replaced the base accuracy stats of all the weapons with the new Bullet Spread mechanic.

Fixed P.P.D.S. continuing to fire even when out of ammo.

Added decimal support to health/damage values in all HUD elements and in Damage Numbers.

Reduced the size of Damage Numbers.

Added extra informational text to the Level 1 and 2 shops.

You now must remove your old Armor in order to purchase new Armor in the shop.



oh yea also i forgot to post the v0.12.2 changelog so here's that now:

\[NEW WEAPON]: P.P.D.S. Precise Poison Distribution System. Burst fire poison pistol. Swag Level 7 Unlock.

\[NEW PASSIVE]: Explosive Rounds. Bullets have a 10% chance to explode on impact, dealing 5 AOE DMG. \[Max: 5]

\[NEW PASSIVE]: Speed Fiend. Move +15% faster. Gain DMG% as you move. You take 35% more damage. \[Max: 4]

\[NEW PASSIVE]: Ruined Hat. P.P.D.S. Mastery Unlock. Dealing damage to an enemy gives them a stacking +10% DMG debuff for 1 second. Capped at 5 stacks. \[Max: 3]

\[NEW RANDOM EVENT]: Risk/Reward. Deal +50% DMG, but take +200% more DMG from all sources.

\[NEW RANDOM EVENT]: Speedrun. Move/shoot +30% faster. Enemies/projectiles move +60% faster.

\[REWORK]: Lead Switch Passive Item. When consuming ammo, gain a chance to add ammo to your next weapon.

\[BUFF]: Armor-Piercing Bullets Passive Item. Now does 25% Piercing, and can stack up to 10 times instead of 5.

\[BUFF]: Compact Gunpowder Passive Item. DMG Debuff when using non-shotgun weapons is now reduced to -10%, instead of -25%.

\[BUFF]: Shell Sling Passive Item. Gain +30% Reload Speed (instead of 25%) while at 60% or more ammo remaining. (instead of 75%).

"Fixed" bug when playing reload animations that require you hold down the button while reload speeds are astronomically fast.

Added "wpn_noprojectiles" to weapons, to clarify weapons that do not (naturally) fire projectiles.

Added "ImpactDeath()" function to projectiles. Called when the projectile crashes onto a wall or floor without hitting an enemy.

General bug fixing for "ImpactActor()", "ImpactWall()", and "ImpactFloor()" functions as well.

Projectiles now have more control over when/if Impact functions are called.

Fix Party Shotgun projectiles floating forever in the air under certain conditions.

Add new suppporter to credits :3

\[LEVEL 3] \[NEW PASSIVE]: Sesame Seeds. Leave a trail of seeds as you move that deal contact damage to enemies. \[Max: 4]

\[LEVEL 3] \[NEW PASSIVE]: Industrial Sized Spring. Grants a double jump. \[Max: 3]

\[LEVEL 3] \[NEW PASSIVE]: Blood Money. Health-based chance to gain regeneration when gaining money. \[Max: 3]

\[LEVEL 3] \[NEW CONSUMABLE]: Beach Ball. Spawns a ball that you can smack around and does 100 DMG to any enemy it touches. \[Max: 5]

notes.title: beta v0.12.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
hello nerds. here's some more patch notes for the playtesters on steam to look at. if you're not a playtester, i guess you can look at this too, but you probably won't understand everything listed here.

Changelog:

(NEW MODIFIER) Double Trouble: Doubles all enemies. Increases Shop Prices by 70%. Unlocked by reaching Swag Level 5.
(NEW MODIFIER) Debilitated: Gives you a new random permanent Debuff every wave. Unlocked by failing 5 Side Quests in 1 run on Level 2.
(NEW RANDOM EVENT) Cursed!: Gives you 2 random Side Quest debuffs. Will be removed upon wave completion.
(NEW DEBUFF) Curse of Yielding: Gives you a stacking -35% Movement Speed debuff upon taking damage.
(NEW DEBUFF) Curse of Fake Bullets: Gives you a 10% chance for your attacks to deal 1 DMG.
(NEW DEBUFF) Curse of Loose Grip: Worsens your weapon's Recoil stat by 2 points.
(NEW DEBUFF) Curse of Slow 'n Steady: Reduces your projectile speed by 50%.
Catalogue Menu descriptions can now be edited by scripts. Currently used by debuffs to properly credit which mechanic gave you the debuff.
Added 6 new functions to Passive Items.
Fred, Ron, and all of their variants now have proper Rotation Sprites, allowing you to better visualize the direction the enemy is facing. 
Added support for custom unlock types to the Unlock Popup HUD.
Fixed Quest/Event HUD not respecting Photo Mode setting.
Fixed Shops being able to telefrag the Player in Level 1.
Improve Fiendish Ron's targeting.
Tweaked the splash screen.
Replaced the blood decals on walls.
Nerfed the "More Onions" debuff.
New supporter added to Credits :3
(LEVEL 3) Finished the basic arena layout.
(LEVEL 3) Added Spear Cat Enemy.

NOTE: All changes marked with (LEVEL 3) are only available via console commands at this time.

Known Issues:

Swag EXP Bar is displayed in the incorrect position on the New Game Menu when playing on aspect ratios other than 16:9.
Some menus can only be navigated with a mouse.

notes.title: beta v0.12 Patch Notes (+ other news)
notes.notes:
hi there. havent posted any updates in this area in a while. so let's catch you up to speed on everything that's new.

A couple weeks ago I released beta v0.12 of DI for playtesters to playtest.

The main headlining feature of v0.12 is the new Weapon Mastery unlocks, which are special shop unlocks for getting 256 kills with a specific weapon. As there are 16 weapons in the game so far, that means this update comes with 16 weapon mastery unlocks, plus 1 default item. 

The total amount of shop items to unlock in the game is now 73.

Now, here's a quick recap of everything added since the october progress update (including the stuff from v0.12):
the game's soundtrack
a minimap
the credits screen
1 new weapon
21 new passive items
3 new consumables
3 new side quest debuffs
2 new side quest objectives
9 new random events
redesigned sprites for a handful of weapons
many other tweaks and improvements

And this is my current to-do list before the game can be released:
Level 3 Arena and Shop finalized
2 new playable characters
4+ new weapons
16+ more shop unlocks
5+ new enemies
some other stuff im probably forgetting

Okay, with all of that out of the way, here's the full changelog of beta v0.12:
NEW FEATURE: WEAPON MASTERY UNLOCKS. Unlock a new item upon getting 256 kills with a specific weapon. The item you unlock is designed to work well with it's corresponding weapon.
NEW FEATURE: Passive Items can now run custom code on all Projectiles spawned by the player. This will let Passive Items easily tweak properties of projectiles, or add new effects to projectiles upon making contact with walls or enemies.
NEW FEATURE: Game now keeps track of what version of the game you last played, and can now reset certain CVARs if it detects you've updated from an older version.
NEW PASSIVE: PIERCING BULLETS. Unlocked by default. Grants +0.2 piercing to your bullets, but also reduces Base DMG by 1. If the bullet is capable of bouncing, the piercing will take priority.
NEW CONSUMABLE: RASPBERRY. Star Pistol Mastery Unlock. Grants +3 Fresh Bonus for 30 seconds on use.
NEW PASSIVE: COMPACT GUNPOWDER. Green Shotgun Mastery Unlock. Grants +25% DMG to weapons with 4 or more projectiles. Otherwise, reduce DMG by 25%.
NEW PASSIVE: SHELL SLING. Double Shotgun Mastery Unlock. Grants +25% Reload Speed if you have at least 75% ammo remaining.
NEW PASSIVE: BOTTOMLESS CLIP. Blue SMG Mastery Unlock. +15% chance to not consume ammo. Reduces Base DMG by 2.
NEW PASSIVE: SPRAY N PRAY. Pink Rifle Mastery Unlock. Reduces accuracy. Grants up to +15% Firerate as your accuracy gets worse.
NEW PASSIVE: JUMP SHOT. Grenade Launcher Mastery Unlock. While jumping, improves Accuracy by 2.
NEW PASSIVE: FONDUE BLOOD. Cheese Cannon Mastery Unlock. Enemies fire burning cheese projectiles on death. The enemy's blood turns yellow.
NEW PASSIVE: OVERWHELMING FIREPOWER. Minigun Mastery Unlock. Grants a stacking +1% Firerate buff everytime you deal damage to an enemy for 2 seconds.
NEW PASSIVE: ORGAN DONOR. Sledgehammer Mastery Unlock. Gibbed enemies will drop +1 coin and +1 regen.
NEW CONSUMABLE: a chicken nugget. Glowstick Mastery Unlock. Upon use, grants +2 HP instantly for every enemy kill for 45 seconds.
NEW PASSIVE: FRESH SPRAY. Popcorn Gun Mastery Unlock. Grants a +15% Firerate buff upon activating a Fresh Weapon Bonus. Lose buff upon switching weapons.
NEW PASSIVE: RUBBER BULLETS. Laser Pointer Mastery Unlock. Bullets now bounce off walls and enemies at 20% velocity.
NEW PASSIVE: POW. Finger Gun Mastery Unlock. While ammo is full, grants +3 Base DMG and +0.5 Piercing. Replaces the firing sound with "POW!". Always active on Finger Gun.
NEW PASSIVE: PROCESSED ORE. Ore Drill Mastery Unlock. Enemies drop +1 coin. Your combo drains +30% faster.
NEW PASSIVE: PARTY POPPER. Party Shotgun Mastery Unlock. Undamaged foes take +20% DMG and spawn confetti on hit.
NEW PASSIVE: ONION RING. Stun Crossbow Mastery Unlock. While enemies are nearby, gain up to +30% Reload Speed.
REWORKED PASSIVE: TOASTER. Now spawns a toaster object at the start of a wave. Passively generates toast pickups at random intervals. Toast grants +4 Regen instantly on pickup. Toaster Passive also grants +20% Firerate buff if you are currently regenerating health. The toaster will stop generating toast if the player has too much health, or not enough enemies have died yet.
Finger Gun bullets are now larger, and gain +2 Piercing, greatly increasing the weapon's lethality.
Reduced the prices for a bunch of damage items.
Increased the price of all Status Bullet items.
Shoe projectile is now 20% more bouncy.
Doubled the price of permanent weapon shops. I want permanent weapons to be something very difficult to get, to encourage players to get permanent passive items instead.
Fixed glowstick pickups giving too much health.
Powerups now no longer decay while in the shop.
Added new VFX to the Starfruit item, so it's easier to tell when it activates.
Added new VFX to the 9 Dollar Bill item, so it's easier to tell when more coins spawn.
Increased the hitbox size of the coin bag.
Buffed the Long Magazine item. No longer reduces player speed, and also now costs less.
Replaced some placeholder sounds on a few weapons.
Passive items can now replace the firing sound of weapons.
Attempted to fix players crashing when using cheat codes to enter level 3.
Fixed inconsistencies between shops in different levels.
Absolutely 100% truly fixed the tracking of weapon kills once and for all. This fix was necessary to make the new features work correctly.
Crosshair is now hidden while the Fullscreen Map is opened.
Updated default controls. Fullscreen Map is now bound to Enter, and the Text Chat button is now unbound. (oopsie)
Particle spawners can now be toggled via the level editor.
More pickups from items will now despawn upon returning to the shop.
Organized the passive item code and projectile code a bit better.
Improved the pathfinding of the Box NPC from the Defender Side Quest Objective, hopefully making the quest less bad.
Did a small amount of work on Level 3. Not ready for public consumption yet.
Made the Lava Arena and the Flooded Arena in Level 2 less annoying.
Replaced the graphic for the ingame cursor.
Gearbox now has new graphics, and starts out larger by default.
DI now requires GZDoom v4.14 to run.
Added new supporter to credits screen :3

Expect to hear more info about Level 3 after v0.12.1 is released later this month.

notes.title: DI: Debt is Inevitable Progress Update
notes.notes:
DI: Debt is Inevitable has been coming along quite nicely now. With each new thing added, it starts to feel more and more like a finished product to me.

So here's a quick recap on what's done in DI so far:

4/6 playable characters completed
15 different weapons completed
40+ passive items completed
10+ consumable items completed
2/3 Main Levels done, complete with their own textures/enemies/shops/mechanics/hazards/etc.


Next up is the 3rd Main Level of DI. I've got some really cool things I want to showcase in this level, but here's a quick rundown of what's planned for it:

2 more playable characters
4 new weapons to mess around with
A slew of new passive/consumable items to unlock
Some funky new mechanics to make this level stand out more from the other 2 levels
A buncha new enemies to populate the level with (every main level comes with it's own set of enemies)


This game has been a solo project of mine, and I had originally planned to be midway through adding Level 3's content by now, but real life occurred and slowed down progress a bit.

So with that being said, I'm officially delaying the release date for DI: Debt is Inevitable to 2025.

I apologize to those whom were looking forward to the 2024 release date. Hopefully you can look forward to the game's release sometime in 2025, and in the meantime, check out my social media stuff for the latest updates on the game :)

notes.title: beta v0.8.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831884/886063126eee2591b10afc953bfb505058d5174a.png
Ok, so we've got some new beta testers trying out DI: Debt is Inevitable here on Steam, so I'll include a copy of the newest update's changelog here for your viewing convenience. :)

IMPORTANT NOTE FOR OLD PLAYERS: If you run into weird issues related to old keybinds, try resetting your controls to default in the options menu. ALSO, I highly recommend setting "Freeze" to On in the "Weapon Wheel" settings found in the gameplay options. It will make using/switching items a lot easier, I promise.

these items are in no particular order.

 NEW MECHANIC: Swag Levels. Gain xp from achieving high scores. Each swag level unlocks new shop item. Current max level is 8. Beating your old score will give you triple the swag.
 NEW MECHANIC: DI now fully supports Time Freeze. Because of this, the option to freeze time while browsing the Weapon/Consumable Wheel is now enabled by default.
 NEW WEAPON: Finger Gun. Decent damage, high recoil. Unlocked at Swag Level 8. (gets easier to unlock with each new character/level you can play.)
 Added 8 unlocks, plus 4 more unlocks that will not be available until v0.9.
 Almost every weapon besides the 3 basic ones are locked behind unlocks now. The Box Party unlocks are currently inaccessible. This is intentional, as they will be added in v0.9.
 Added support for new addon file.
 Shop and Permaitems now supports item bundles.
 Bomb Shop Item is now a bundle item, containing 5 bombs.
 buffed double shotgun.
 fix VM abort caused by lack of weapons.
 flipped the position of Burger and Box on player select menu.
 added option to keep perma consumables in inventory bar when depleted.
 removed unused box party script.
 fixed a buncha misc things that broke because of time freeze.
 improved text in option menu tooltips a little.
 new unlock popups can now display up to 3 popups at once, instead of just 1.
 tweaked the item pool a bit.
 nerfed rewards program and credit fraud.
 reworked debt reduction and borrowed HP to try to make mechanic harder to cheese.
 organized the unlock menu.
 started work on new character for next update. includes new starting weapon, which is also incomplete.
 buffed heart bomb.
 attempt a fix for death mark not gibbing enemies.
 buffed firestarter.
 adjusted the prices of some items.
 last stand has a chance to prevent you from dying.
 buffed cheese gun and burger player.
 FINALLY fixed perma items sometimes giving wrong items.
 nerfed Fresh Regen.


many of the changes in this update were made in preparation for the new content being added in v0.9. be sure to look forward to that :)
